name: Blood pressure (systolic and diastolic)
definition: Auscultatory systolic and diastolic blood pressure in mmHg measured by physician examiners using a calibrated mercury sphygmomanometer after 5 minutes of seated rest.
comparison_note: Auscultatory clinic blood pressure reflects daytime resting arterial pressure and incorporates situational alerting (white-coat) effects. Continuous cuffless wearable estimates (optical pulse transit time, PTT) and ambulatory 24-hour recordings (ABPM) are distinct physiological measurement paradigms and must not be pooled with clinic auscultation.
